definitions.explanation: A table or list showing errors found in a published document along with their corrections. Commonly included as an insert in books or posted on websites when errors are discovered after publication.

examples.japanese: {正誤表|せいごひょう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}のサイトに{正誤表|せいごひょう}が{掲載|けいさい}されている。
examples.english: The errata are posted on the publisher's website.

examples.japanese: {教科書|きょうかしょ}に{誤|あやま}りが{見|み}つかったため、{正誤表|せいごひょう}が{配布|はいふ}された。
examples.english: Errors were found in the textbook, so an errata sheet was distributed.

notes:
Literally 'correct-incorrect table.' A standard publishing term. Composed of {正|せい} (correct) + {誤|ご} (error) + {表|ひょう} (table/chart). Textbook publishers and academic publishers commonly provide these.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正誤表|せいごひょう}を{作成|さくせい}する: to create an errata list
- {正誤表|せいごひょう}を{掲載|けいさい}する: to publish an errata list
- {正誤表|せいごひょう}を{配布|はいふ}する: to distribute an errata sheet

RELATED WORDS:
- {訂正|ていせい}: correction — the act of correcting
- {誤植|ごしょく}: typo, misprint — an error in printed text
- {校正|こうせい}: proofreading — checking for errors before publication
- {増補改訂版|ぞうほかいていばん}: revised and expanded edition
